definitions.explanation: Lack of justice or fairness. Actions or situations that are not right or proper.
Illegal or dishonest conduct, especially in official or business matters.

notes:
{不正|ふせい} refers to injustice, unfairness, or fraud.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不正|ふせい}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ (fraudulent act)
- {不正|ふせい}⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧ (unauthorized access)
- {不正|ふせい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (election fraud)
- {不正|ふせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (commit fraud)

- ⟦{不公平|ふこうへい}→不公平：16851_fukouhei⟧: unfairness (lack of equality)
